pages.title: Busted!
pages.text: Plays when the police catch you. A cop car pays more to skitch than any other ride, but if they spot you, you are fined and out of the race. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Officer's lines
pages.text: The cops have jokes. 'You're skitchin', and I'm scratchin'.' On the ticket, that is. Another thanks you for helping him make his quota for the day.

pages.title: The ad
pages.text: EA's ads asked 'Remember Road Rash?!' and called the game 'Skatin', Hitchin', Bitchin''. Kids wrote angry letters; EA's publicist said bitchin' just means excellent, and it rhymes.
